import pytest
from refunds.processor import Payment, process_refund, ExcessiveRefundError


def test_over_charge_refund_is_rejected():
    p = Payment(id="p3", charged_amount=50.0)
    with pytest.raises(ExcessiveRefundError):
        process_refund(p, 50.01)
explanation: Redundant assertion of the over-charge rejection path. The existing suite already covers single and cumulative over-refunds, so the mutation is killed and this repair is not needed; included for completeness.
rationale: Asserts an over-charge refund is rejected, the behavior the existing suite already protects.
